statement: Source review before solver implementation: the existing dynamic prime F4 API uses28 variables and a concrete64-bit coefficient context; generic Buchberger has a5000-pair cap, which alone is not a complete work or allocation bound. Immutable source snapshots and primary-source reading scope are retained. PKM2016 low-degree-composition/generalized-root-finding results and Kosters--Yeo warnings do not supply a solving-degree or attack-exponent bound for this fixed-six-sum Curve25519 target law. No solver was run and no new algorithmic or novelty result is claimed.
